scope: Known related-work grouping sensitivity for the 204 eligible movie/series IDs after explicitly restoring Resident Evil (2026). Partial grouping; not an exhaustive unseen-franchise guarantee.
decision_policy: Only manual direct-film-series, repeated-character, adaptation-family or spin-off relations in the reviewed 30 rules are grouped.
Group construction and rule selection use titles/plot evidence only; no liking category, model performance, genre performance or error pattern is used.
Union overlapping accepted relation rules transitively, then give every unassigned eligible IMDb ID its own unique singleton group.
Distinct movies and series remain distinct rows; the manifest only constrains fold co-location.
The two Chaplin films remain separate singleton groups because a shared director/performer alone does not establish a franchise.

Keep the three-film Superman/Justice League group separate from the Dark Knight trilogy. Thor, Captain America, Black Panther, Deadpool, X-Men and Spider-Man retain their narrow reviewed series groups; do not unite all Marvel/DC works merely by studio, genre or a known broad universe.

limitations: The rule set is conservative and incomplete. Shared universes, crossovers, retellings and characters can cross these group boundaries; a singleton can still be related to another title.

For example, Avengers, Loki, WandaVision and Doctor Strange can share a universe with narrow Marvel movie groups; this manifest does not claim to isolate that full universe. Deadpool & Wolverine has a crossover relation to X-Men that is not automatically expanded here.
The Dark Knight versus Superman/Justice League distinction intentionally preserves reviewed film-continuity groups, even though the Batman character can still recur across them.
Related-work-held-out results using this manifest test robustness to these explicit relation rules, not performance on every wholly unseen franchise.
Grouping can change fold composition and label balance. The training/evaluation owner must report per-fold support and ensure train/test group disjointness after splitting.
No external family metadata or exhaustive franchise ontology was collected; manual title and synopsis judgments remain documented assumptions.
